title: Distribute Repeating Integers
description:
Given an integer array `nums` with at most 50 distinct values and customer order quantities `quantity`, decide whether all customers can be satisfied.

Customer `i` must receive exactly `quantity[i]` elements of `nums`, all with the same value. Each element may be given to at most one customer. Unused elements are allowed. Return `true` if such a distribution exists, otherwise `false`.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: nums = [1, 2, 3, 4], quantity = [2]
Output: false
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: nums = [1, 2, 3, 3], quantity = [2]
Output: true
```

### Example 3

```text
Input: nums = [1, 1, 2, 2], quantity = [2, 2]
Output: true
```

## Constraints

- n == nums.length
- 1 <= n <= 10^5
- 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000
- m == quantity.length
- 1 <= m <= 10
- 1 <= quantity[i] <= 10^5
- There are at most 50 unique values in nums.
